name: United States CPI (index)
description: The national all-items consumer price index as the International Monetary Fund publishes it (dataflow IMF.STA:CPI). The Fund labels its reference period 2010A. This is the Fund's copy, for a like-for-like G20 row: the Bureau of Labor Statistics' own index is `cpi_nsa`. The Fund's file has no entry for October 2025, which the Bureau did not publish.
